stance: Growth: consumer spending is firm. September retail sales rose 0.77% m/m after 1.29% in August, with ex-auto at 0.72% and yoy at 6.29%. September IP rose 0.66% m/m (yoy 2.25%) and capacity utilization rose to 76.85%, so production confirms activity is firm. Consensus and control group were unavailable, so the GDP consumption read is unconfirmed. Would turn cautious if ex-auto retail m/m goes negative, IP reverses, or ISM New Orders fall below 50.
